links.evidence: On July 5, 2018, we and Embraer S.A. (Embraer) announced the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding to establish a strategic partnership between the two companies.
Ingram Micro Inc. ("Ingram Micro"), our second largest distributor, accounted for 10 % , 11 % , 8 % of Autodesk's total net revenue for fiscal years ended January 31, 2020 , 2019 , and 2018 .
Samsung Electronics, Co., Ltd. (Samsung), accounted for approximately 7% , 14% and 25% of our total revenue in fiscal years 2016 , 2015 and 2014 , respectively.
One of our customers, Han's Laser, headquartered in China, accounted for 12%, 13% and 9% of our net sales in 2018, 2017 and 2016, respectively.
During 2023, Lightsource BP was the only customer that accounted for 10% or more of our modules business net sales
In December 2017 we entered into a new collaboration agreement with Ionis Pharmaceuticals Inc. (Ionis) to identify new antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) drug candidates for the treatment of SMA.
Lenovo Group Limited accounted for 11% of our net revenue (9% in 2011 and 8% in 2010)
The principal customers of our heavy-duty truck engines include truck manufacturers such as ... Navistar International Corporation (Navistar)
